meta.name: task-coordination-strategies
meta.description: Decompose complex tasks, design dependency graphs, and coordinate multi-agent work with proper task descriptions and workload balancing. Use this skill when breaking down work for agent teams, managing task dependencies, or monitoring team progress.

copy.tagline: 拆解复杂任务，协调多个代理高效执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要带领多个 AI 代理一起完成复杂任务
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex tasks and coordinate multiple agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to lead multiple AI agents to finish complex tasks together

howto.what: Claude 会把复杂任务拆成可并行的小块,设计 blockedBy/blocks 依赖关系,写出含目标、文件归属和验收标准的任务描述,并监控各 teammate 负载、重新分配任务、找出关键路径。
howto.when: 当你要求把复杂工作拆给多个 agent、设计任务依赖,或监控团队进度时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个全栈功能拆成可并行任务,并标出依赖关系
say.note: 产出任务清单与 blockedBy 关系

say.text: 给 implementer 1 写一份带验收标准和文件归属的任务描述
看看谁空闲谁过载,把待办重新分配一下

howto.what_en: Claude decomposes complex work into parallel units, designs dependency graphs (blockedBy/blocks), writes task descriptions with objectives, owned files and acceptance criteria, and monitors teammate workload to rebalance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to break work down for agent teams, design task dependencies, or monitor team progress.

say_en.text: Break this full-stack feature into parallel tasks and map the dependencies
say_en.note: Returns a task list with blockedBy links

say_en.text: Write a task description with acceptance criteria for implementer 1
Check who's idle or overloaded and reassign the pending tasks
say_en.note: Assesses with TaskList, reassigns via TaskUpdate
